source: A14_MODULE_REGISTRY.md s2.4 (the registry transcribed from code on disk) + P0 SPEC ADDENDUM part contracts (the five opening part rows; A13 s3 opening pool)
laws: honesty law absolute - a module absent from this manifest does not exist to the game (A14 s2.1); forbidden axes stay DECLARED at level 0 in trust.py's CHARTER (inspectable refusal, never silence); on drift CODE WINS - a vanished module keeps its row and renders LOST SIGNAL, never silent repair (A14 s4.3); the three-state split: REGISTERED = a row here, UNLOCKED = unlock_act in journey_save.json done{}, SLOTTED = the id in a construct spec - three files, three sets, never merged

capability_vocabulary.note: extensions transcribed verbatim from the A14 s2.4 table; the vocabulary extends only by book amendment

grid.note: substrate - ungated; write-state is the meter

energy.note: zone law enforced in-module; the power bus every part draws through - never itself a part

speak.note: checked live in controlroom.py before every TTS call

recall.note: the organ must NOT exist before the pair session opens (A9 rule 1)

orchestrator.note: proven in isolation, not wired - promotes after the think forge (A14 s2.4)

swarm.note: proven in isolation, not wired - promotes after the think forge (A14 s2.4)

relay.note: proven in isolation, not wired - promotes after the think forge (A14 s2.4)

pathfinder.note: proven in isolation, not wired - promotes after the think forge (A14 s2.4); partial per ORGANS_DOC

agent_tools.note: act-external = web_fetch, json_get; compute = calc - the one eval in the organ population, regex-fenced, scrubbed builtins (A14 s2.5); benches after the wire forge (queue 3)

telegram_bridge.note: bound operator chat only; NO CHARTER ROW - named gap, closes at P4 with notify_operator (A14 s6.4)

reflect.note: its own envelope: no internet, no effectors, no keys; the entity's, not the player's

hades.note: substrate - they ARE the law; the gate wraps every construct, a construct cannot slot the gate

config.tier: local | reflex | solid | frontier - pinned by the bench task's tier_floor at P0
config.zone: the construct spec's zone word (the zone law) - the one writable dial on the P0 plate
config.prompt_source: task - the bench task supplies the prompt at P0

tap.note: THE POWER INLET - thin wrapper over energy.draw, no new organ; payload {text, latency_ms, tried[], plant, model} (P0 SPEC ADDENDUM part contract); binds no charter row at P0 - the trust law still evaluates at fire time

config.template: plain | bench - the prompt scaffold template

scaffold.note: the prompt scaffold - shapes the task prompt before the draw; pure transform, nothing leaves

governor.note: refuses before any spend (GRAFT-A1: order is semantics); read-only at P0 - writable at P9 with policy cards

ladder.note: the ranked rods for tier x zone; rod order surfaces at P1+

scorer.note: receipt-measured fields ONLY: {pass, axes: {latency_ms, tokens, ok, zone}} - no model-judged quality number at P0 (part contract)
